descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S01 「完整的模式来回切换：列表、模板、面板、没有 Clinic、不串数据」 Full context round-trip: lists, templates, panels, no Clinic, no bleed

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1e Quick Dictation is available in Hospital and absent in Nursing Home（UAT TC-21 step 1；UAT TC-04） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U2 Template list: Hospital offers exactly H&P, SOAP progress, Consult note and Discharge summary; Nursing Home offers exactly SNF admission, SNF follow-up, SNF consult and SNF discharge (not the prototy …（UAT TC-21；UAT TC-21 step 1 (template list)；TFA-92599 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U3 A&P Only, Brief Progress, Addendum and Outpatient Consult are absent (removed, not deprioritized)（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U5 No Clinic anywhere: absent from the context switcher and from the template picker（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 4；TFA-92599 AC 9） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu …（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U9 Nursing Home has Save & Extract, a billing block and a Medications panel, all working (none were present in Run 6)（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician with one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident (synthetic)

When Agent runs the TC-21 browser case: Hospital list → Nursing Home list → resident chart → back to Hospital chart → Hospital list

Then Every checkpoint below holds

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：scripts/oracle.mjs mustContain/mustNotContain per checkpoint. Missing SNF consult/discharge is reported as Fail (known: TFA-92599 AC 2). The `url` fields are not checked yet (runnerGaps R1), so each checkpoint's content (own patient present, other context's absent) decides the route.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
